description: Na₄Ti₅O₁₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.46 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.91 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.76 Å. There are five inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.09 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.43 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.44 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.07 Å. In the fifth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.08 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and three Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three equivalent ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaTi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONaTi₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramid, corners with three ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Ti atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaTi₃ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramid, and edges with four ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaTi₃ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramid, and edges with four ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONaTi₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂Ti₃ trigonal bipyramids.
